name: props_combustion_phi_sweep
source:
{ Adiabatic flame temperature (frozen products, Thermochemistry) swept over the
  whole legal equivalence-ratio range plus the reactant-temperature clamp.
  Java: Newton from T=2000, Math.clamp(t-step, tReact, 6000), exit when
  |tNext - t| < 1e-6, 100 iterations, else throw. Very lean phi drives the
  balance toward tReact (lower clamp); the guards at phi<=0 and phi>1 must
  classify identically. }
ch4_phi_005 = AdiabaticFlameTemp('CH4', 0.05, 298.15)
ch4_phi_01  = AdiabaticFlameTemp('CH4', 0.1, 298.15)
ch4_phi_02  = AdiabaticFlameTemp('CH4', 0.2, 298.15)
ch4_phi_04  = AdiabaticFlameTemp('CH4', 0.4, 298.15)
ch4_phi_06  = AdiabaticFlameTemp('CH4', 0.6, 298.15)
ch4_phi_08  = AdiabaticFlameTemp('CH4', 0.8, 298.15)
ch4_phi_09  = AdiabaticFlameTemp('CH4', 0.9, 298.15)
ch4_phi_099 = AdiabaticFlameTemp('CH4', 0.99, 298.15)
ch4_phi_1   = AdiabaticFlameTemp('CH4', 1.0, 298.15)

c8_phi_05   = AdiabaticFlameTemp('C8H18', 0.5, 298.15)
c8_phi_1    = AdiabaticFlameTemp('C8H18', 1.0, 298.15)
c3_phi_07   = AdiabaticFlameTemp('C3H8', 0.7, 298.15)
c3_phi_1    = AdiabaticFlameTemp('C3H8', 1.0, 298.15)
h2_phi_1    = AdiabaticFlameTemp('H2', 1.0, 298.15)
meoh_phi_1  = AdiabaticFlameTemp('CH3OH', 1.0, 298.15)
etoh_phi_1  = AdiabaticFlameTemp('C2H5OH', 1.0, 298.15)
c2h2_phi_1  = AdiabaticFlameTemp('C2H2', 1.0, 298.15)

{ preheated reactants and a cold-clamp case }
ch4_hot     = AdiabaticFlameTemp('CH4', 1.0, 700)
ch4_hotter  = AdiabaticFlameTemp('CH4', 1.0, 1200)
ch4_verylean_hot = AdiabaticFlameTemp('CH4', 0.01, 900)
ch4_cold    = AdiabaticFlameTemp('CH4', 1.0, 200)
ch4_alias   = AdiabaticFlameTemperature('CH4', 0.8, 298.15)
ch4_alias2  = FlameTemp('CH4', 0.8, 298.15)

{ combustion helpers at the same conditions }
afr_ch4     = StoichAFR('CH4')
afr_c8h18   = StoichAFR('C8H18')
afr_ch3oh   = StoichAFR('CH3OH')
lhv_ch4     = HeatingValue('CH4', 'LHV')
hhv_ch4     = HeatingValue('CH4', 'HHV')
lhv_c8h18   = HeatingValue('C8H18', 'LHV')
hhv_c8h18   = HeatingValue('C8H18', 'HHV')
lhv_h2      = HeatingValue('H2', 'LHV')
hhv_h2      = HeatingValue('H2', 'HHV')
mm_ch4      = MolarMass('CH4')
mm_c8h18    = MolarMass('C8H18')
